parameters.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.review_status, a.execution_status, i.source_reference
  FROM public.agent_actions a
  JOIN public.incidents i ON i.incident_id = a.incident_id
  WHERE a.id = $1::bigint AND a.incident_id = $2::uuid
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) AS action_exists,
  (SELECT review_status FROM target) AS review_status,
  (SELECT execution_status FROM target) AS execution_status,
  (SELECT source_reference FROM target) AS source_reference;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.agent_actions
SET execution_status = 'executed',
    executed_at = now(),
    execution_error = NULL,
    telegram_message_id = $2
WHERE id = $1::bigint AND review_status = 'approved'
RETURNING id AS action_id, execution_status;

UPDATE public.agent_actions
SET execution_status = 'retry', execution_error = $2
WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id AS action_id, execution_status, execution_error;
